function.name: changelog.Add
function.description: Log that a new symbol (function, struct or interface) was added to a file.

path.description: Relative path to the changed file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

description.description: One-line description of what was added.

function.name: changelog.Change
function.description: Log that an existing symbol (function, struct or interface) was changed.

path.description: Relative path to the changed file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

function.name: changelog.Deprecate
function.description: Log that an existing symbol (function, struct or interface) was deprecated.

path.description: Relative path to the changed file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

description.description: One-line description of why the symbol is deprecated and what replaces it.

function.name: changelog.Fix
function.description: Log that an existing symbol (function, struct or interface) was fixed.

path.description: Relative path to the changed file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

function.name: changelog.Remove
function.description: Log that an existing symbol (function, struct or interface) was removed.

path.description: Relative path to the changed file, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

description.description: One-line description of why the symbol was removed.

function.name: changelog.List
function.description: List all changelog entries ordered by date with type, file, symbol and description.

function.name: changelog.Search
function.description: Search changelog entries by file path and an optional symbol. Omit symbol to list every entry for the file.

path.description: Relative path to a file or folder, e.g. "./utils/Parse.go"

symbol.description: Optional symbol filter, e.g. "Parse". Omit to list all symbols.
